name: Stolen Thunders and Feathers
source:
The phantom thief known as Tokozu Kujaku (Peacock Thief) threw Starburst City into chaos for six months - before disappearing without a trace, with promise of an "Ultimate Heist."

Two years later, Junior Detective Wayne Reed arrives at his office to find two messages. Those two messages send him on a journey all around the city. Can he find out what's going on and possibly find a connection to the Phantom Thief's "Ultimate Heist"?

[From [url=https://katiemay.itch.io/stolen-thunders-and-feathers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
被称为“孔雀贼”的怪盗让星爆城陷入了六个月的混乱，然后就消失得无影无踪，并承诺进行“终极抢劫”。

两年后，初级侦探韦恩·里德来到他的办公室，发现两条信息。这两条消息让他踏上了环城之旅。他能查出到底发生了什么，并可能找到与怪盗团“终极抢劫”的联系吗？

[来自[url=https://katiemay.itch.io/stolen-thunders-and-feathers]itch.io[/url]]
